theorem lemma_4_13 (a₀ : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (h₀ : 0 ≤ a₀) (ha : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ a t)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Ici 0)) (hmono : AntitoneOn f (Ici 0))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Ici 0, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, a t * f (a₀ + ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), a i)) ≤
      ∫ x in a₀..(a₀ + ∑ i ∈ range T, a i), f x
rows.exact_Prop:
∀ (a₀ : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℕ),
    0 ≤ a₀ → (∀ t < T, 0 ≤ a t) →
    ContinuousOn f (Ici 0) → AntitoneOn f (Ici 0) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ici 0, 0 ≤ f x) →
    (∑ t ∈ range T, a t * f (a₀ + ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), a i)) ≤
      ∫ x in a₀..(a₀ + ∑ i ∈ range T, a i), f x
